tasks.title: Create posts préfaits infrastructure and scripts
tasks.description: Build the pre-made posts system with a queue file, HTML template, generation script, and publishing script for Instagram/Facebook posts, following the Vexel model but branded for Krystine.
tasks.details:
1. Create scripts/posts/ directory with:
   - file.json: Queue of posts to generate (array of { id, caption, image, cta, scheduled, status })
   - gabarit.html: HTML template for post rendering (Krystine brand: V2 colors, Fraunces/Inter fonts)
   - generer.mjs: Script to render gabarit.html with Playwright, output to public/pubs/posts/
   - publier.mjs: Script to post to Meta Graph API (Instagram/Facebook)
2. Template design:
   - Background: V2.creme (#f4efe6)
   - Typography: Fraunces for headlines, Inter for body
   - Accent: V2.or (#7d6330) for highlights
   - Include photo frame with V2.filet (#9c7a44) border
   - Dimensions: 1080×1080 for Instagram, 1200×630 for Facebook
   - No italics, no em-dash (per Alex's rules)
3. Generation script:
   - Read file.json
   - For each post with status "ready": render HTML template with data
   - Screenshot at correct dimensions using Playwright
   - Save to public/pubs/posts/{id}.jpg and {id}-ig.jpg
   - Update status to "generated"
4. Publishing script:
   - Check for META_ACCESS_TOKEN in environment
   - Read generated posts with status "generated"
   - Upload to Meta Graph API
   - Update status to "published" with timestamp
   - If token missing, save to Desktop with instructions
5. Schedule: plist to run every 2 days (following Vexel model)
6. Add error handling and logging to scripts/posts/posts.log

file.json structure:
```json
[
  {
    "id": "2026-09-23-ayurveda-tip",
    "caption": "Un rituel matinal qui change tout...",
    "image": "https://storage.googleapis.com/inspirata/...",
    "headline": "Rituel Ayurvédique",
    "body": "Commencez votre journée avec...",
    "cta": "www.krystinestlaurent.ca/formations",
    "scheduled": "2026-09-23T09:00:00Z",
    "status": "ready"
  }
]
```
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test generer.mjs creates correct image dimensions (1080×1080, 1200×630)
2. Verify generated images match Krystine brand (V2 colors, fonts, no italics)
3. Test publier.mjs uploads to Meta API successfully (with valid token)
4. Test fallback behavior when token is missing (save to Desktop)
5. Verify file.json status updates correctly through the pipeline
6. Test error handling (invalid image URL, API errors)
7. Verify logging captures all operations to posts.log

tasks.title: Create Vexel press kit page (no toggle, always public)
tasks.description: Build a /presse page for the Vexel site with Vexel branding (black/white, Merriweather/Outfit, chrome aesthetic), containing press assets and visuals. This page is always public, no visibility toggle required.
tasks.details:
NOTE: This task requires information about the Vexel site location. Based on PRD, the Vexel site should be at ~/Documents/Websites/vexel-site or similar. The task assumes the Vexel codebase follows similar React/TypeScript patterns.

1. Locate Vexel site directory (likely ~/Documents/Websites/vexel-site)
2. Create src/pages/PressePage.tsx in Vexel codebase
3. Apply Vexel branding:
   - Colors: Pure black (#000000), Pure white (#FFFFFF)
   - Typography: Merriweather (serif, for headlines), Outfit (sans-serif, for body)
   - Aesthetic: Chrome/metallic accents, sharp edges, high contrast
   - No glassmorphism (that's Krystine's L'Œuvre brand)
4. Structure similar to Krystine press kit:
   - Facts section (Vexel agency info, portfolio highlights)
   - Visual assets (1920×1080 project screenshots, case studies)
   - Logos (Vexel wordmark, icon, variations)
   - Agency description and services
   - Client list and testimonials
   - ZIP download for complete kit
5. Generate assets via scripts/presse/build-kit.mjs (Vexel-specific)
6. Add route /presse (and /press, /press-kit aliases)
7. NO visibility toggle (page is always public)
8. Ensure .env.local is present for deployment
9. Verify /compte route works after deployment

Vexel color scheme:
```typescript
const VEXEL = {
  noir: '#000000',
  blanc: '#FFFFFF',
  chrome: '#C0C0C0',
  accent: '#1a1a1a',
};
```
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Run boucle-verdict with Playwright screenshots at 1440px and 390px
2. Verify Vexel branding is consistent (black/white, Merriweather/Outfit)
3. Test all asset downloads work (images, logos, ZIP)
4. Verify page is publicly accessible (no auth required)
5. Test on local dev server and after deployment
6. Verify .env.local is configured and /compte route works
7. Check contrast and readability on both dark and light displays
8. Validate no Krystine branding appears (no crème colors, no Fraunces font)
